posts.zh:
dsh-bloom-theme 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Bloom 莫兰迪主题：四款变体（雾蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、花瓣 petal、涟漪 ripple）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，八组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3f0e5335afe0597b764d.html
posts.en:
dsh-bloom-theme is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bloom Morandi theme: four variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all eight foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3f0e5335afe0597b764d.html
